messages.subject: Project Harbor — completion statement & funds
messages.plaintextBody:
Rebecca, Isla,

Completion statement attached. Balance due from Thornbury on completion is £28,706,607.86 (price £32.4m less the £3.24m deposit, net of apportionments and including the £15k Penrose retention and the assigned Brunswick rent deposit). Please arrange for cleared funds to reach our client account by 10.00am on 27 February. SDLT of £1,609,500 follows within 14 days.

James
